customManagers.description: tools.lock.toml names the loot-rs version and tag that Cargo.toml links, and a test keeps them equal. Follow the same loot-rs release tags so the lock moves with the Cargo.toml tag.
The tag line of the same loot-rs entry.

packageRules.description: Cargo: keep caret requirements so the Components link together; exact versions live in Cargo.lock.
Crates from crates.io wait 7 days after publication, as Cargo does (.cargo/config.toml). The organisation's own git dependencies have their own rules.
One pull request per loot-rs release: the Cargo.toml tag, Cargo.lock and both tools.lock.toml lines move together, in the group the shared preset gives first-party Cargo git dependencies.
